name: protein tyrosine phosphatase non-receptor type 14

function.text: PTPN14 encodes tyrosine-protein phosphatase non-receptor type 14. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in lymphangiogenesis and protein dephosphorylation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to lymphedema-posterior choanal atresia syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Basal Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
